name: White Turtlehead
desc: White Turtlehead (Chelone glabra): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 2 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Chelone glabra, or white turtlehead, is a herbaceous species of plant native to North America. Its native range extends from Georgia to Newfoundland and Labrador and from Mississippi to Manitoba.
